name: Crafti
author: Fabian Vogt, gameblabla
description_short: A lightweight Minecraft-inspired block-building sandbox powered by the nGL 3D engine
description_long: Crafti is a block-building sandbox game originally created by Fabian Vogt for TI-Nspire calculators and ported to GameCube by gameblabla. Built on the fixed-point nGL engine, it features procedurally generated 3D terrain, block placement and destruction, and an inventory system without relying on floating-point math. The GameCube alpha runs in 480i; progressive scan can be forced through Swiss.
